The Weekly Pinch of Shopping: Tasty New Products to Try

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 6:43
Instaread

Welcome to your latest Pinch of Shopping! There’s a bit of everything in this week’s trolley, including handy breakfast options and sweet treats, speedy lunch ideas, and a few bits to make dinner feel a little more exciting. 

We’ve spotted some cracking flavour combos, useful shortcuts, and a couple of offers worth knowing about too.

And don’t forget, if you’re looking for even more cooking inspo — plus loads of ways to get organised in the kitchen — Meal Prep is officially on the shelves! Click here or the image below to grab a copy!

Here’s what we couldn’t resist this week…

Tesco Houmous Platter 280g – 222 calories per ½ pack

       

If your idea of a good snack involves a bit of dipping and plenty of choice, this houmous platter caught our attention. It’s the sort of thing that can sit happily in the middle of the table when you’ve got people round, or make a handy addition to a picky lunch.

For a homemade alternative, our Hummus-Style Dip goes with all sorts. Serve it with crunchy veg, pitta, or as part of a spread.

Tesco Houmous Platter 280g is available from Tesco, priced at £3.25 per platter — or just £2.75 with your Clubcard.

Fancy getting your dip on?

Nanna Tate Garlic-tastic Buttery Tates 400g – 181 calories per ½ pack

Garlic and buttery potatoes are two things that don’t need much convincing, and these are a lovely way to get them onto your plate!

If you’re after a potato side with plenty of texture, our Rustic Potato Wedges are a great place to start. They’re chunky, crispy and work alongside all sorts of mains.

Nanna Tate Garlic-tastic Buttery Tates are available from Tesco, priced at £1.75 per pack — and you can get any 3 for the price of 2 with your Clubcard.

Time to give your spuds their moment in the spotlight.

Plenish Clean Protein Oat Chilled 1L – 40 calories per 100ml

This next one’s a plant-based milk that ticks quite a few boxes for breakfast fans: it’s vegan, high protein, zero sugar and made with just four ingredients. 

We’d be tempted to put it to work in a breakfast recipe, and there are plenty of oat-based ideas on the Pinch of Nom website. Our Apple and Custard Overnight Oats work really well if you like getting breakfast sorted ahead of time.

Plenish Clean Protein Oat Chilled is available from Tesco, priced at £2.65 per carton — or just £2 with your Clubcard.

Make tomorrow morning a little easier.

Tesco Chocolate & Hazelnut Flavour Filled Waffles 272g – 169 calories per waffle

Chocolate and hazelnut is a combo that has a habit of disappearing sharpish in our kitchen, so these waffles caught our eye!

If waffles are firmly on your breakfast agenda, our Chocolate Waffles are worth bookmarking. They’re chocolatey, freezer-friendly, and make a fun homemade breakfast when you’ve got a little more time. 

Tesco Chocolate & Hazelnut Flavour Filled Waffles are available from Tesco, priced at £1.95 per packet.

Get the waffle maker out.

Morrisons Mackerel Katsu Curry – 129 calories per ½ can

Mackerel and katsu curry might not be the pairing you immediately expect, but that’s exactly what makes this one interesting!

For another take on the katsu theme, our Katsu Chicken Curry is packed with all those delicious flavours.

Morrisons Mackerel Katsu Curry is available from Morrisons, priced at £1.30 per can.

Fancy a katsu night?

Jacob’s Bites Sea Salt & Malt Vinegar 125g – 119 calories per 25g serving

These salt and vinegar bite-sized snacks look like the sort of thing that could find their way into a packed lunch, movie-night bowl, or afternoon snack.

If you’re in the mood for something more substantial alongside your snack, why not start with some soup?

Jacob’s Bites Sea Salt & Malt Vinegar are available from Morrisons, and right now they’re reduced to just £1.25!

Pass the bowl, please.

Nature Valley Crunchy Cocoa & Hazelnut 5 Pack – 195 calories per bar

Cocoa and hazelnut is back again, this time in crunchy bar form. Pop these in your bag when you’re heading out and know you’ll be peckish later on!

For a homemade oat-based option, you could take a look at our Banana Baked Oat Bars for a little baking inspiration. They’re a fab reminder that oats go further than your breakfast bowl!

Nature Valley Crunchy Cocoa & Hazelnut 5 Pack, and right now they’re just £1.75 per packet.

Pop one in your bag and save yourself a snack-time scramble.

Sainsbury’s Honey & Almond Kefir Overnight Oats 350g – 256 calories per ½ pot

Overnight oats are having another moment, and this pot brings honey, almond and kefir together for an easy breakfast option. 

If you fancy making your own version, our Apple and Blackcurrant Overnight Oats can be prepped ahead of time, ready to go when breakfast rolls around. 

Sainsbury’s Honey & Almond Kefir Overnight Oats, priced at £2.75 per pot.

Breakfast sorted before you’ve even found your socks.

Geeta’s Silky Butter Chicken 340g – 171 calories per 100g

Butter chicken is a curry-house classic, and Geeta’s silky version has our attention!

If this has put you in the mood for curry night, our Creamy Butter Chicken is a Pinch of Nom fave for a reason.

Geeta’s Silky Butter Chicken is available from Sainsbury’s, priced at £3.50 per jar.

This is your sign to have a curry night.

New Covent Garden Food Co. Katsu Chicken with Rice & Red Peppers Lunch Pot 300g – 374 calories per pack

When lunchtime needs to be speedy, a ready-made pot is always a welcome sight in the fridge. This one brings together katsu chicken, rice and red peppers in a single portion, and it’s a good source of fibre too.

If you want even more katsu flavour, our Cauliflower Katsu is a tasty veggie version. 

New Covent Garden Food Co. Katsu Chicken with Rice & Red Peppers Lunch Pot is available from Sainsbury’s, priced at £3.50 per pot.

Katsu cravings sorted.

Remember: We don’t accept payment or gifts to include any of the products above — we just love them, and we hope you will too.

Don’t forget – we love seeing what you’re picking up in your weekly shop! Tag us or post in our Facebook group if you spot anything slimming-friendly and tasty that deserves a shoutout.
